theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ _, .choice h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor; rintro x y (hc|hb)
    · exact .choice hc.symm
    · exact .bisim hb.symm
  · rintro x y (hc|hb) μ z hz
    · cases hz with
      | choiceL hp => exact (hc.follow_fst hp).imp fun _ t => ⟨Tr.choiceL t.1, .bisim t.2⟩
      | choiceR hs => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR hs, .bisim <| HomBisimilarity.refl _⟩
    · exact (hb.follow_fst hz).imp fun _ t => ⟨t.1, .bisim t.2⟩
